## Highlights

- Scrub managed project-verifier environments and terminate their owned process groups on timeout,
  including descendants that retain output pipes.
- Cache one-shot leader-exit observations and distinguish live process-group permission failures
  from the bounded Darwin owned-zombie notification race.
- Keep selector-construction failures inside owned cleanup for bounded capture, advisory preflight,
  safe Git, and managed verifier Git helpers.
- Replace avoidable 100 ms capture and Git polling with kernel event waits bounded by the actual
  monotonic deadline.
- Share managed parser/service contract constants and remove unreachable path-based Agent Skill
  walkers while retaining the complete descriptor-based historical upgrade ledger.

## Compatibility and safety

There are no intentional command-line, policy-schema, or exit-code breaking changes in this
release. Managed CLI direct-script behavior and legacy monkeypatch seams remain supported. The
explicit `install-skill` command is documented as the sole vendor-recognized-path persistence
exception and still publishes only the exact reviewed bundle to selected personal Skill roots.

Verifier environment scrubbing and process-group cleanup are local integrity and availability
controls, not host confinement. Use an external container or jail when vendor or verifier code is
hostile.

The final complete Codex Security diff scan reviewed all nine changed production source files and
retained no finding. Full validation passed 1,514 tests with 35 skips, extracted-sdist isolation,
Ruff and format checks, strict mypy, package builds, and the complete Linux/macOS CI matrix.

## Installation

```sh
uv tool install --upgrade "weightclass==0.26.0"
brew upgrade ictechgy/tap/weightclass
```
